item.title: Exploring CV + MPE Control with Touché and ERAE
item.description: video upload by Oddment "Exploring the Expressive E Touché and ERAE Touch to control ODD-1 via CV and MPE. This is an informal first look — more structured demos of specific CV and MPE techniques coming soon. Gear in this video: Expressive E Touché, ERAE Touch, ODD-1. Many, many thanks to ‪@Abyssolune‬ for loaning me the ERAE Touch for our MPE development!"

item.title: The Story Behind MIDI Amsterdam // Modulogue
item.description: video upload by Modulogue "We visited Tim Nieuwenhuis' music store: 'MIDI Amsterdam', a staple in the Dutch electronic music scene for almost 30 years. Tim talks about the origin of his store, his passion for electronic music, the famous artists he's encountered over the years, and more! MIDI Amsterdam https://midiamsterdam.nl/"
